trigger: The first combined-calibration launch exited before Qwen completion, but the immutable historical public failure slot could not record the new sanitized stage code.

allowed_change.restricted_child_result: Return either the existing aggregate-safe success receipt or a fixed-schema error envelope containing only a bounded internal failure code.
allowed_change.public_failure_history: Write the retry failure, if any, to a new additive versioned public artifact rather than overwriting the historical pre-acquisition failure.
allowed_change.resume: Reuse only already validated exact checkpoints from the identical frozen run.

forbidden_changes: causal protocol, seeds, learner, controls, or endpoints
